points.title: 童年与成长
points.description: 艾森豪威尔出生于堪萨斯州阿比林的一个贫困家庭，是七个儿子中的第三个。他的父亲是一家乳制品厂的工人，母亲是虔诚的基督徒。尽管家境贫寒，艾森豪威尔通过勤奋工作和自学获得了教育机会。他在阿比林高中表现出色，特别是体育方面，并获得了西点军校的提名。这段艰苦的童年经历培养了他坚韧不拔的性格和强烈的责任感，为他后来的军事生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Abilene, Kansas to a poor family, Eisenhower was the third of seven sons. His father worked at a creamery and his mother was a devout Christian. Despite financial hardships, Eisenhower gained educational opportunities through hard work and self-study. He excelled in academics and sports at Abilene High School, earning an appointment to West Point. This difficult upbringing fostered his resilience and strong sense of responsibility, which would later shape his military career.

points.placeEn: United States Military Academy at West Point
points.title: 军校生涯
points.description: 艾森豪威尔进入西点军校学习，虽然成绩中等，但在体育方面表现突出，特别是橄榄球和拳击。1915年毕业时，他在全班名列倒数第五。在西点期间，他培养了纪律性和领导能力，并建立了广泛的人脉网络，这些关系在他后来的军事和政治生涯中发挥了重要作用。西点的教育强调团队合作和服从命令，这些理念深深影响了他的领导风格。
points.descriptionEn: Eisenhower attended West Point, where he achieved mediocre academic results but excelled in sports, particularly football and boxing. Graduating in 1915, he was ranked 61st in a class of 164. During his time at West Point, he developed discipline and leadership skills while building a network of connections that would prove crucial in his later military and political career. The academy's emphasis on teamwork and following orders profoundly influenced his leadership style.

points.title: 二战盟军统帅
points.description: 艾森豪威尔在二战期间迅速崛起，被任命为欧洲战区盟军最高司令官。他成功策划并指挥了北非战役、西西里登陆和诺曼底登陆等重大军事行动。1944年，他晋升为五星上将，成为美国历史上仅有的九位五星上将之一。作为盟军最高统帅，他展现了卓越的战略眼光和外交才能，成功协调了来自不同国家的军队，克服了盟军内部的分歧，最终击败纳粹德国。这段经历使他成为世界知名人物，为他后来的政治生涯奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Eisenhower rose rapidly through the ranks, becoming Supreme Commander of the Allied Expeditionary Force. He successfully planned and commanded major military operations including the North Africa campaign, the invasion of Sicily, and the D-Day landings in Normandy. In 1944, he was promoted to General of the Army, one of only nine five-star generals in U.S. history. As Supreme Allied Commander, he demonstrated exceptional strategic vision and diplomatic skills, coordinating forces from different nations and overcoming internal Allied divisions to ultimately defeat Nazi Germany. This experience made him internationally famous and laid the foundation for his later political career.

points.title: 战后军事领导
points.description: 二战后，艾森豪威尔担任陆军参谋长(1945-1948)，负责美国陆军战后重组。1949年，他成为北约第一任最高司令官，负责组建和指挥北约军队。在这一时期，他积极参与美国冷战战略的制定，主张建立强大的常规军事力量作为威慑。同时，他开始涉足政治领域，与共和党领导人建立联系，为1952年的总统竞选做准备。他在华盛顿的军事和政治活动使他积累了丰富的国家治理经验，并建立了广泛的跨党派人脉。
points.descriptionEn: After World War II, Eisenhower served as Chief of Staff of the U.S. Army (1945-1948), overseeing the post-war reorganization of the Army. In 1949, he became the first Supreme Commander of NATO, responsible for organizing and commanding NATO forces. During this period, he actively participated in formulating U.S. Cold War strategy, advocating for strong conventional military forces as a deterrent. Simultaneously, he began to engage in political circles, building relationships with Republican leaders in preparation for the 1952 presidential campaign. His military and political activities in Washington provided him with extensive experience in national governance and broad bipartisan connections.

points.title: 总统任期
points.description: 艾森豪威尔于1953年当选美国第34任总统，连任两届。任内，他结束了朝鲜战争，推行了大规模的州际公路系统建设，签署了《民权法案》的初步版本。在外交政策方面，他提出了'大规模报复'战略，建立了中央情报局，并支持中东的'艾森豪威尔主义'。他关注冷战局势，处理了柏林危机和匈牙利革命等国际事件。尽管面临麦卡锡主义等国内政治挑战，艾森豪威尔保持了相对温和的政治立场，试图在保守派和自由派之间寻求平衡。他的总统任期见证了美国战后经济的繁荣和冷战格局的形成。
points.descriptionEn: Eisenhower was elected as the 34th President of the United States in 1953, serving two terms. During his presidency, he ended the Korean War, initiated the construction of the Interstate Highway System, and signed the first version of the Civil Rights Act. In foreign policy, he implemented the 'massive retaliation' strategy, established the CIA, and supported the Eisenhower Doctrine in the Middle East. He addressed Cold War situations, handling international events like the Berlin Crisis and the Hungarian Revolution. Despite domestic political challenges such as McCarthyism, Eisenhower maintained a relatively moderate stance, attempting to balance between conservative and liberal factions. His presidency witnessed America's post-war economic prosperity and the formation of the Cold War格局.

points.title: 退休生活
points.description: 1961年艾森豪威尔卸任总统后，与妻子玛米回到宾夕法尼亚州盖茨堡的农场度过退休生活。他撰写了两本回忆录，包括《白宫岁月》，并担任哥伦比亚大学名誉校长。尽管退休，他仍关注国内外政治，特别是对冷战局势保持警惕。1969年3月28日，艾森豪威尔因心力衰竭在华盛顿沃尔特·里德陆军医疗中心逝世，享年78岁。他被安葬于阿比林的艾森豪威尔总统图书馆。他的退休生活体现了他对和平的向往和对国家未来的持续关注，同时也为后来的退休总统树立了先例。
points.descriptionEn: After leaving the presidency in 1961, Eisenhower retired with his wife Mamie to their farm in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania. During his retirement, he wrote two memoirs, including 'At Ease: Stories I Tell to Friends,' and served as a trustee at Columbia University. Despite his retirement, he remained attentive to national and international politics, particularly maintaining vigilance about Cold War developments. On March 28, 1969, Eisenhower died of heart failure at Walter Reed Army Medical Center in Washington, D.C., at the age of 78. He was buried at the Eisenhower Presidential Library in Abilene. His retirement years reflected his desire for peace and continued concern for the nation's future, setting a precedent for former presidents.

supporter.zh: 艾森豪威尔被视为美国历史上最伟大的总统之一，他的领导才能和战略眼光在二战和总统任期内得到充分体现。支持者赞扬他成功结束了朝鲜战争，推动了州际公路系统建设，促进了美国战后经济繁荣。他被视为一位能够团结不同政治力量的领导人，在冷战期间维护了美国的安全与稳定。艾森豪威尔的军事成就和政治遗产使他成为美国历史上的标志性人物，他的领导风格强调团队合作、务实决策和长远规划。
supporter.en: Eisenhower is regarded as one of America's greatest presidents, with his leadership abilities and strategic vision fully demonstrated during World War II and his presidency. Supporters praise him for successfully ending the Korean War, initiating the Interstate Highway System, and promoting post-war economic prosperity. He is seen as a leader capable of uniting different political forces, maintaining America's security and stability during the Cold War. Eisenhower's military achievements and political legacy make him an iconic figure in American history, with his leadership style emphasizing teamwork, pragmatic decision-making, and long-term planning.

critic.zh: 批评者指出艾森豪威尔在冷战政策上过于强硬，导致军备竞赛加剧和国际紧张局势。他在麦卡锡主义盛行时期未能及时制止政治迫害，被指责对民权运动反应迟缓。经济方面，尽管任内美国经济繁荣，但批评者认为他未能有效解决收入不平等问题。外交政策上，他支持的中东干预政策被批评为帝国主义行为。此外，艾森豪威尔被指责在处理古巴革命和越南问题上判断失误，为后来的美国深陷越南泥潭埋下伏笔。
critic.en: Critics point out that Eisenhower's Cold War policies were too hardline, exacerbating the arms race and international tensions. They fault him for failing to promptly stop political persecutions during the McCarthy era and for being slow to respond to the civil rights movement. Economically, despite America's prosperity during his presidency, critics argue he failed to effectively address income inequality. His interventionist policies in the Middle East are criticized as imperialistic. Additionally, Eisenhower is blamed for misjudgments in handling the Cuban Revolution and Vietnam issues, which laid the groundwork for America's later entanglement in the Vietnam quagmire.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，艾森豪威尔被定义为一位过渡性但关键的领导人，连接了二战后美国的不同时代。他既是战争英雄又是和平时期的总统，体现了美国从战时经济向和平时期转型的复杂性。历史学家普遍认可他的行政能力和外交手腕，但也承认他在民权等社会问题上的局限性。流行文化中，艾森豪威尔常被描绘为'沉默的一代'的代表，象征着战后美国的保守主义价值观。他的形象既包括军事统帅的威严，也有平民总统的亲和力，成为美国战后历史的重要象征。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Eisenhower is defined as a transitional yet pivotal leader connecting different eras of post-World War II America. He was both a war hero and a peacetime president, embodying the complexities of America's transition from wartime to peacetime economy. Historians generally recognize his administrative abilities and diplomatic skills while acknowledging his limitations on social issues like civil rights. In popular culture, Eisenhower is often portrayed as a representative of the 'Silent Generation,' symbolizing post-war American conservative values. His image combines the authority of a military commander with the accessibility of a civilian president, making him an important symbol of American post-war history.

self.zh: 不要仅仅因为事情困难而放弃尝试。困难使它们值得尝试。
self.en: Do not merely stand at the door of the temple of knowledge, but enter its courts, and learn to love its majesty and its power.

others.zh: 艾森豪威尔是一位伟大的将军，但更是一位伟大的总统。他理解权力的本质，并知道如何使用它。
others.en: Eisenhower was a great general, but he was an even greater president. He understood the nature of power and knew how to use it.
